defaults.title: Frontend JS errors spiking against the 1h baseline

params.name: spike_factor
params.doc: times the baseline rate that fires

params.name: baseline_minutes
params.doc: minutes before the window that set the baseline rate

params.name: min_errors
params.doc: fewer errors than this in the window never fire

defaults.title: Frontend Largest Contentful Paint p75 is poor

params.name: threshold_ms
params.doc: p75 LCP in milliseconds that fires (Core Web Vitals call above 4000 poor)

params.name: window_minutes
params.doc: minutes the percentile is computed over

params.name: min_samples
params.doc: fewer LCP measurements than this in the window never fire

params.name: client_timeout_min_sessions
params.doc: distinct browser sessions a client-side timeout issue (a request the browser gave up on, or a connection stall) must reach before NewIssue fires for it; the issue itself opens at once. 1 pages on first sight like any other issue

defaults.title: A resolved issue came back in a later release
An issue's error rate is spiking against its previous day
An uptime check failed several probes in a row (warning), then many (critical)

params.name: failures
params.doc: consecutive failed probes that raise UptimeCheckFailing (warning)

params.name: critical_failures
params.doc: consecutive failed probes that raise UptimeCheckDown (critical) instead

params.name: window_minutes
params.doc: minutes of probes considered; keep it above failures times the check's interval

defaults.title: A probed certificate expires within 14 days (warning) or 3 days (critical)

params.name: warn_days
params.doc: days to expiry at or below which CertificateExpiring (warning) fires

params.name: critical_days
params.doc: days to expiry at or below which CertificateExpiringSoon (critical) fires instead, an expired certificate included

defaults.title: A declared telemetry target's scrape keeps failing (up = 0)

params.name: window_minutes
params.doc: minutes back the newest scrape result of each endpoint is looked for; keep it above the scrape interval

defaults.title: A declared telemetry check has not succeeded for 5 minutes

params.name: window_minutes
params.doc: minutes of probes considered: the check fires when none of them succeeded

defaults.title: A promoted release did not converge
Observability usage is at or over its monthly allowance (warning from 100%, critical from 150%)
